blind.description: A stylized wooden storage rack with a vertical wooden plank backing and three tiers. The top two shelves each hold three dark metal miner's lamps/lanterns with brass trim bands and glass chambers. The bottom shelf holds a small wooden open crate packed with several cream-colored cylindrical candles. The woodwork has a worn, mossy dark green stain on the posts and natural brown wood for the shelves and backing.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular brown wooden shelf flanked by two green end posts, showing the circular domed caps of three dark lanterns arranged in a horizontal line.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.5 to 4 ft tall), and about 2.5 ft wide.
